evidence.expiry: 限セクション ヒットなし。ITコンサルにコンセッション/特許束の期限型独占なし→no
evidence.dom: 堀セクション ヒットなし。蝕より『If we are unable to compete successfully, we could lose market share and clients to competitors』『Competitors may be willing, at times, to take on more risk or price contracts lower than us in an effort to enter the market or increase market share』→断片化した競争市場・ACN単独シェア40%未満→50
evidence.irr: 『Managed Services 34,566』(総売上69,673の約49%)=複数年アウトソーシングで移行摩擦高い一方、Consulting側(51%)は案件型で切替容易→ブレンドで70
evidence.rep: 『greater competition』かつ同規模の競合(Deloitte/IBM/TCS/Infosys等)が既にモデルを複製済み→複製は困難だが不能ではない→60
evidence.dur: 堀の主性質はManaged Services多年契約のスイッチングコスト→75
evidence.geopol: 『represented approximately 36% of Health & Public Service revenues, 15% of Americas revenues and 8% of total revenues in fiscal 2025』(政府調達依存8%)+『we could be subject to criticism in connection with our incorporation in Ireland』(アイルランド籍)→中=1
evidence.erosion: 『we could lose market share and clients to competitors』『price contracts lower than us in an effort to enter the market or increase market share』=競争圧力は存在するが売上+9.5%CAGR・営利率横ばいで顕在化せず→emerging
evidence.disrupt: 蝕の技術代替キーワード明示ヒットなし。競争・価格圧力は継続、AIは需要とディスラプトの両面で未決着→unsettled
evidence.moatdecay: 売上CAGR9.5%・ROIC(のれん除き)約92%で高位安定・規模拡大継続→no
evidence.p4: 誠の『material weakness』ヒットは『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, and testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness』=監査手続の定型文で指摘事実ではない。『Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments None』。accr=-5.8%(<0)+無限定想定→90
